title: docs(spec): re-anchor the dashboard `chartConfig` liveness row to the current objectui pin
body:
Part of #17385 — the ruling-free half only. Two of the card's three deliverables stopped at the dispatch fence and are handed back as options instead, so #17385 stays open. Written by an `os-dev` in PM session `session_01MkQhmuuJAVDjmeWNixwDDH`.

Clause-②: no — a liveness row is a claim ABOUT the schema, not the schema. No Zod shape, no authorable key and no accept set moves in this diff.

## What changed

One row's evidence text in `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json` — `widgets.children.chartConfig`. Its `status` is untouched (`live`), no schema key moves, and the row still carries no per-key `children`. `verifiedAt` advances to the date of the re-measurement.

## What was measured

The card's premise was that the row reads `"status": "live"` with the evidence sentence *"chart-config bag forwarded to the chart renderer"*. **That premise is stale** — objectstack#7016 replaced that sentence on 2026-08-09, and the row has carried a nine-key breakdown ever since. The card's "12 declared keys" is also off: `ChartConfigSchema` declares **14** (`type`, `title`, `subtitle`, `description`, `xAxis`, `yAxis`, `series`, `colors`, `height`, `showLegend`, `showDataLabels`, `annotations`, `interaction`, `aria`). The count of 12 traces back through objectui#4044 to objectstack#5175, whose own body lists fourteen items under the label "12".

What IS false is different, and it took resolving every path and symbol the row cites, in the repo it names, to see it.

**1. The citation moved repos-internally.** The row cites `objectui @230ffd875: packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:380-429`. At that commit the pointer is byte-exact: `chartConfigPresentation`'s body occupies exactly 380-429 and all ten sub-line citations land on their key — `:390 showLegend`, `:391 showDataLabels`, `:393 title`, `:395 subtitle`, `:397 description`, `:401 height`, `:403 annotations`, `:405 interaction`, `:419` and `:425 colors`. At this checkout's own `.objectui-sha` pin `53ded82bf7a4`, that same range is a doc comment plus a **re-export block**: objectui#4877 lifted the function into `@object-ui/core`'s `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts`, beside the derivation it merges onto. Nothing mechanical could have caught this — `check:liveness` counts foreign paths and never resolves them, deliberately, so only a hand re-measurement finds it.

**2. Three of the five "unforwarded" keys are forwarded.** The row's note said nine keys reach the renderer and five do not, naming `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `series` as derived from the dataset selection so that an authored value would shadow the derived binding. objectui#4229 ruled that half right and shipped the split it implies. At the pin, `DatasetWidget.tsx:1415` calls `mergeAuthoredPresentation(series, widget?.chartConfig)` and `:1529` spreads the result onto the chart schema. So **12 of the 14 keys reach the renderer on this face, not 9.**

**3. The two that still do not are `type` and `aria`**, for different reasons. `type` is deliberate — the widget's own `type` picks the chart family through `CHART_TYPE_MAP`, and objectui pins that nothing outranks it — while the same key is live on the react tier as a published flat `dataProps` entry in `ui/react-blocks.ts`. `aria` has no reader on either face: the chart implementation declares no `aria` prop, the ARIA injection reads the flat `ariaLabel` / `ariaDescribedBy` / `role`, and the react block's `dataProps` omits it.

### Controls

Every absence claim carries both controls, because a count is not a reading until you look at what it matched.

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| `chartConfig` in `DashboardRenderer.tsx` at the pin, `grep -o` piped to `wc -l` (occurrences, not lines) | **0** |
| lit control: `DashboardRenderer` in the same file | **18** |
| dark control: `zzchartConfigzz` in the same file | **0** |
| lit control: `packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts` at the pin | resolves |
| dark control: `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/NoSuchWidget.tsx` at the pin | absent |

### The gate can go red on this row — proved, not assumed

An ablation on the committed tree: delete ONE `objectui` realm marker from the new evidence so the following path is read as repo-local. The mutation was confirmed on disk by blob hash, not by an editor's exit code.

```text
HEAD blob:     93dabafa8790d2ff4fc607db7751ef95454cb0a6
mutated blob:  4c7a22edbb9dc4ad57bc9f0ceb62ccb1664bc26d
MUTATED   check:liveness exit=1
          dashboard/widgets.chartConfig -> packages/core/src/utils/chart-presentation.ts
restored blob: 93dabafa8790d2ff4fc607db7751ef95454cb0a6   (== HEAD)
git diff HEAD after restore: []
RESTORED  check:liveness exit=0
```

The restore leg is `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap with an absolute path, and it is proved by blob equality plus an empty `git diff HEAD`, never by an exit code.

## Where this stopped, and why

The dispatch fence: correcting the row's evidence text is in scope; changing what the row GRADES is not. Two of the card's deliverables land on the far side of it.

**The per-key `children` drill cannot be written honestly at this coordinate.** Two of the fourteen keys have no in-vocabulary verdict here. `type` is live on the react tier and inert on the dashboard face — a per-face split, which the 2026-09-10 ruling on objectui#4044 explicitly forbids inventing a ledger shape for (「⛔ 不收窄声明、不发明「按面 live」的台账形状」). `aria` has no reader on any face, so its honest verdict is `dead` — an ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove entry on a published authorable key, which is the retirement trigger the fence reserves for the maintainer. And a third fact makes the whole drill weaker than it looks: **the liveness walk drills exactly ONE level** (`check-liveness.mts` reads `led.children[ck]` and never a child's own `children`), so a `children` map written under `widgets.children.chartConfig` sits at depth two, where no evidence is resolved, no key is reported unclassified, and no container reconcile applies.

**The protocol precedence half is silent here and already answered there.** `dashboard.zod.ts:365` declares `chartConfig: ChartConfigSchema.optional().describe('Chart visualization configuration')` and ADR-0021 says only that `ChartConfigSchema` "stays shared". Neither states what wins when an authored axis meets a dataset-derived one. objectui shipped an answer anyway, and it is a fourth option the card does not list: a per-KEY split rather than a per-key ruling. Recording it in the protocol is a protocol decision, so it goes back with the options rather than being written in.

## 验收备注

- **Noted, not filed** — no clock relates a cited `objectui @SHA` to this repo's own `.objectui-sha` pin. Twenty-one distinct objectui commits are cited across the ledger files; `verifiedAt`'s 180-day threshold is the only freshness signal, and this row was 8 days inside it while describing a renderer two refactors back. Carrier: the objectui pin-bump procedure in `docs/releases-maintenance.md`, which is the recurring operation that touches exactly this.
- **Noted, not filed** — the one-level drill above is a silently-dropped-metadata trap for the next author of this file. Carrier: #17385 itself, whose remaining scope is that very drill.
